_meta.title: GridWise - Unofficial Edge Case Pack
_meta.event: BUP CSE Fest 2026 - Hackathon - Online Preliminary
_meta.origin: UNOFFICIAL. Authored from the Problem Statement rules to stress boundaries the 10 public samples do not reach. Not organizer ground truth.
_meta.reference_solver: Reference plans and costs were produced by an LP (signed net battery flow + solar use, HiGHS) that reproduces the official optimal cost on all 10 public sample cases to within 0.01 BDT.
_meta.grading_note: Cases with grade_interpretation=false have no defined ground truth in the Problem Statement. Their interpretation is not compared; only schema validity, self-consistency and plan validity are checked.
how_to_use: Compare directive_interpretation against expected_output.directive_interpretation where grade_interpretation is true.
Replay hourly_plan against the ground-truth directives, effective solar, battery rules, energy balance and end-of-day neutrality.
Compare your total_cost_bdt against expected_output.total_cost_bdt; equal or lower with a valid plan is full credit.
Do not hard-code any wording, id or number from this pack.

cases.label: Single-hour window

operator_notes: Battery charging is locked out from 3 PM to 4 PM for a breaker swap.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: End-exclusive convention on the smallest possible window: 3 PM to 4 PM is exactly one hour, [15]. Teams who inclusively expand to [15,16] fail.

cases.label: Window ending at midnight

operator_notes: Do not discharge the battery from 10 PM until midnight while the relay is being swapped.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Midnight as an end boundary must map to hour 24 exclusive, giving [22,23]. A wrap to hour 0 is wrong.

cases.label: 24-hour clock wording

operator_notes: PV production will drop to about 20% between 13:00 and 15:00.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Same directive as the public solar cases but written on a 24-hour clock. This is verbatim from Section 11.4 of the Problem Statement.

cases.label: Fraction-word solar output

operator_notes: Panel washing from eleven in the morning until two in the afternoon will leave roughly one-fifth of normal solar output.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Spelled-out times and a spoken fraction. 'One-fifth of normal output' is what remains, so factor = 0.2, not 0.8.

cases.label: Total solar outage

operator_notes: There will be no usable solar at all from 9 AM until noon during the inverter replacement.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Boundary value factor = 0.0, which the guardrail must accept (0 and 1 are inclusive). 'Noon' as an exclusive end gives [9,10,11].

cases.label: All notes are distractors

operator_notes: The cafeteria will switch to the new summer menu next Monday.
IT is rolling out a campus WiFi firmware update this weekend.
Convocation rehearsal has been moved to the auditorium.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Three notes, zero directives. Every entry must still be returned with applies=false and structured_adjustment=null. The plan is the unconstrained optimum.

cases.label: Reserve as percentage of capacity

operator_notes: Emergency operations require at least 60% of battery capacity to remain stored from 7 PM until 10 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Relative reserve language: 60% of the 240 kWh capacity is 144 kWh. The model must read capacity from the request, not guess.

cases.label: Window starting at hour 0

operator_notes: Grid import must not exceed 120 kWh in any hour from midnight until 4 AM while the feeder is under test.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Midnight as a start boundary is hour 0. Tests the lower edge of the hour range.

cases.label: All-day reserve directive

operator_notes: Keep at least 70 kWh in the battery at all times today.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: 'At all times today' expands to all 24 hours. Tests a full-length hours array and a reserve above the base minimum.

cases.label: Charging disabled for the whole day

operator_notes: The battery charger is out of service for the entire day.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: With charging forbidden all day and end-of-day neutrality required, the only valid plan keeps the battery idle for 24 hours. Tests whether the optimizer can find the degenerate-but-valid solution instead of declaring infeasibility.

cases.label: Tight evening grid cap

operator_notes: Grid intake is capped at 150 kWh per hour from 5 PM until 9 PM because the substation is derated.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Demand in those hours exceeds the cap, so the battery must be pre-charged earlier and discharged into the capped window. Fails any optimizer that treats the cap as a soft preference.

cases.label: Flat tariff, no arbitrage

operator_notes: Do not charge the battery from 1 PM until 4 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: A flat tariff removes every arbitrage opportunity, so the cheapest valid plan is battery-idle. Tests that the optimizer does not churn the battery for no gain and still lands on the true optimum.

cases.label: Zero-solar day with reserve

operator_notes: Keep no less than 90 kWh in the battery between 6 PM and 9 PM.
The new bike racks will be installed near Gate 2.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: No solar anywhere in the day. Every solar_used_kwh must be 0 and the plan must still balance, hold the reserve and end neutral.

cases.label: Solar reduction over night hours

operator_notes: Solar output will be down to 10% from 2 AM until 5 AM during the string test.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: The directive is real and must be reported with applies=true, but it lands on hours where solar is already 0, so cost is unchanged. Tests that teams do not suppress a directive just because it has no economic effect.

cases.label: Battery starts at its floor

operator_notes: Grid import must stay at or below 175 kWh from 6 PM until 9 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: initial_energy_kwh equals minimum_energy_kwh, so the battery cannot discharge until it has charged first. Tests bound handling at the lower edge.

cases.label: Battery starts full

operator_notes: Do not charge the battery from 8 AM until 11 AM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: initial_energy_kwh equals capacity_kwh, so no charging is possible until the battery discharges, and neutrality forces it back to full by hour 23. Tests the upper bound edge.

cases.label: Three simultaneous directives

operator_notes: Cloud cover leaves about 40% of forecast solar from 11 AM until 2 PM.
Keep at least 100 kWh in the battery from 6 PM until 9 PM.
Grid import must not exceed 185 kWh per hour from 7 PM until 10 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: The maximum note count with three different directive types interacting in overlapping evening hours. A reserve floor and a grid cap pull in opposite directions and both must hold.

cases.label: Reserve at full capacity

operator_notes: The battery must be completely full from 4 PM until 6 PM ahead of the grid test.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Reserve equal to capacity is the extreme legal value: the guardrail must accept reserve == capacity and the plan must hit it exactly in those hours.

cases.label: Overlapping same-type directives

operator_notes: Solar will be at 50% from 10 AM until 2 PM for the array inspection.
During the actual panel wash from noon until 1 PM, expect only 10% of normal output.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Two solar_reduction directives overlap on hour 12. Both must be reported separately and exactly as written; the optimizer must apply the more restrictive factor (0.1) where they overlap.

cases.label: Energy-flavoured distractor

operator_notes: The solar panel warranty renewal paperwork is due to the vendor next quarter.
Do not discharge the battery from 11 AM until 1 PM during the relay calibration.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Note 0 is full of energy vocabulary (solar, panel, battery vendor) but changes nothing about today's 24-hour schedule. Keyword-matching interpreters will wrongly fire a directive here.

cases.label: Halve wording

operator_notes: Expect rooftop solar to be halved from 9 AM until noon.
Keep a minimum of 85 kWh in the battery from 8 PM until 11 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: 'Halved' is a verb form with no digits at all; the factor 0.5 has to be inferred from the word. Paired with a late-evening reserve window.

cases.label: Reduction percentage vs remaining percentage

operator_notes: There will be a 75% reduction in solar output from 12 PM until 3 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: The trap pair to EDGE-05: a 75% reduction leaves factor = 0.25, not 0.75. This single sign error silently invalidates every affected hidden case.

cases.label: No-discharge across the peak

operator_notes: The battery must not discharge from 5 PM until 8 PM during protection testing.
Charging is also unavailable from 5 PM until 8 PM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: Charging and discharging are both blocked across the most expensive hours, so the battery is effectively frozen there and all peak demand must come from the grid. Tests that the optimizer does not quietly relax an expensive constraint.

cases.label: Ambiguous overnight wrap (robustness only)

operator_notes: Do not charge the battery from 11 PM until 1 AM.

expected_output.plan_summary: Reference schedule: applies every ground-truth directive, satisfies all GridWise constraints, and achieves the minimum grid cost.

cases.rationale: The Problem Statement does not define wrap-around windows. Interpretation is NOT graded here; the case exists to confirm the service returns a valid, non-crashing, self-consistent plan on ambiguous input. Whatever hours you emit, your own plan must obey them.
